1479-2841-8100-8293.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-8100-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

792-4279-6094--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-6094--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3220-3249-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3220-3249-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2638-2841-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2638-2841-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-856-2173-5220.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
728-856-2173-5220.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
728-856-2173-5220.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1636-2681-2930-7870.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token under an opponent's control.
When the Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
Activate Hawkeye by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Spirit token. This'll destroy it due to it having 0 toughness.
Hawkeye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

553-6555-7468.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Whirlwing Stormbrood // Dynamic Soar.
In response, cast Swat Away by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

2021-2060-2445-4029.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

280-1558-2638-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1558-2638-4231-7810.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1895-4399-4518-6097.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4518-6097.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a level counter on it

4091-5832-7791.description:
Activate Joraga Treespeaker by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Joraga Treespeaker.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Joraga Treespeaker.
Repeat.

1017-1494-4067-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2511-4120-4186-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
2511-4120-4186-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Scurry Oak, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1456-2292-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1456-2292-4871-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2292-4446-4681-5170.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2292-4446-4681-5170.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

851-4365-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
851-4365-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev and Mondrak.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
851-4365-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4659-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4659-5789.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

4499-5902-7009.manaNeeded: {3} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
4499-5902-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an untapped land you control

651-3588-4943.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}.
Task Force triggers, giving it +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate the land with Animal Boneyard attached by tapping it and sacrificing Task Force, causing you to gain life equal to Task Force's toughness.

141-3047-3967.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

339-677-969-3967.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

38-3705-4314-4871.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Pawn of Ulamog and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skirk Prospector ability.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3174-3967-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
3174-3967-5434-5555.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Yahenni by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4289-4365-4885.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

862-2538-3676-5187.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Guardian Project triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Guardian Project trigger, causing you to return Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1228-3967-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-3967-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

4053-5147-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
4053-5147-5944.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero stun counters due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

4131-4893-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith that is a 4/4 Construct with haste named Mishra's Warform.
Activate Mishra's Warform's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Mishra's Warform's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

943-2404-4235.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
943-2404-4235.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Gaea's Cradle.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and Gaea's Cradle
Repeat
943-2404-4235.notes: With excess mana, you can instead untap another land instead of Gaea's Cradle.

2084-4615.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2084-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

2232-2368-3475-5220-5299.notablePrerequisites: The World Spell has exactly two lore counters on it.
2232-2368-3475-5220-5299.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The World Spell triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The World Spell's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to put Tom Bombadil onto the battlefield from your hand and sacrifice The World Spell.
Mortuary, Cloudstone Curio and Tom Bombadil each trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting The World Spell on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Tom Bombadil trigger, causing you to reveal The World Spell from the top of your library and put it onto the battlefield.
Choose to have The World Spell enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Cloudstone Curio and The World Spell's third chapter ability trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Tom Bombadil to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the World Spell trigger, causing you to put Tom Bombadil onto the battlefield from your hand and sacrifice The World Spell.
Repeat from step 3.
If desired, you may return a creature card to your hand in step 5, which can then be returned in step 2 for infinite blinking of any creature(s).

579-1812-3793-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
579-1812-3793-4222.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding six {C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

174-339-1636-4050.notablePrerequisites: Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
174-339-1636-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Worldheart Phoenix enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
